evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫 (CUHK Multi-function Chinese Character Database)
evidence.field: 字形; 形義通解; 《說文》; cited uses
evidence.text: The entry displays a small-seal form, a bronze example, and manuscript forms; no oracle-bone form is shown in this entry. It analyzes 渴’s bronze form as 水 plus sound element 曷, reports an older use for 竭 (“dried up/exhausted”), and quotes Shuowen’s 盡也 and 从水、曷聲. It separately cites a Shijing use meaning thirsty, a Tang use meaning dry/parched, and a Gongyang use meaning urgent. These are the database’s analyses and cited examples; they do not establish the earliest physical witness of the Shijing line or every semantic transition.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫: 渴

evidence.field: 渴-seal.svg description; source, label, license and upload record
evidence.text: The file description identifies 渴-seal.svg as a digital vector depicting 渴 in Shuowen seal-script style. It names several source leads, including Sinica Database and CUHK’s Multi-function Chinese Character Database, and points to hanziyuan.net image S08263. The mirrored metadata reports public-domain status, says attribution is appreciated but not required, and records a 2014 upload by Micheletb. The mirror was accessible through search results, but opening it returned a cache miss; the exact Commons description page, imageinfo response, and original remote SVG were inaccessible in this invocation.

search_audit.outcome: Search surfaced mirrored Commons metadata identifying the file as a modern SVG rendering of a Shuowen seal form, with S08263 as a source lead and public-domain licensing claim. Opening the Wiktionary mirror returned a cache miss; hanziyuan.net was inaccessible. Metadata was not enough to verify the exact remote asset pixels or independently validate rights.

gaps: Exact Commons description page, official MediaWiki imageinfo response, and direct original SVG were inaccessible. The visible file metadata came from a Wiktionary mirror surfaced in search results, not an opened Commons record.

The local SVG was not treated as externally verified provenance, nor as proof that its current pixels match the remote Commons file. Rights status is only reported by the mirrored metadata; current official rights could not be independently verified.
Xiaoxuetang’s character-specific 渴 record and rights notice were not retrieved in this pass; no CC0 alternative candidate was established.

CUHK’s received small-seal form is relevant as a later script form, but the opened character entry does not verify that the candidate vector exactly reproduces it. The image’s precise source form/date cannot be securely established from the inspected primary pages.

limitations.text: CUHK catalogs a received small-seal form, but the exact Commons record and asset could not be opened, and the mirrored metadata does not independently establish that the candidate SVG pixels match the catalogued form. Candidate identity and current rights therefore remain unverified; no image is selected.
